hints.en: The loop condition is `while len(titles) < n:`; `break` on an empty page; at the end `titles[:n]`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"


def newest(n):
    titles = []
    page = 1
    while len(titles) < n:
        body = requests.get(BASE + "/books", params={"sort": "-year", "per_page": 5, "page": page}).json()
        if not body["data"]:
            break
        titles.extend(book["title"] for book in body["data"])
        page += 1
    return titles[:n]


for title in newest(7):
    print(title)
```

The solution:

```python
import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"


def newest(n):
    titles = []
    page = 1
    while len(titles) < n:
        body = requests.get(BASE + "/books", params={"sort": "-year", "per_page": 5, "page": page}).json()
        if not body["data"]:
            break
        titles.extend(book["title"] for book in body["data"])
        page += 1
    return titles[:n]


for title in newest(7):
    print(title)
```

hint.tr: 7 kitap için 2 sayfa yeter; gereğinden fazla sayfa istendi.
hint.en: Two pages are enough for 7 books; more pages than needed were requested.
